# What this document does

The noise-free SEIR and SIR BiLSTMs of `Clean_any_length.Rmd` (trained on every new infection,
windows of 30 to 365 days from any part of an epidemic) on **real data, with windows of 30 to
180 days**, next to the four search-based methods of the package:

| Method | How it estimates |
|---|---|
| BiLSTM (SEIR or SIR) | one pass of the trained network (average of 5 seeds); R0 range from its calibration windows |
| ABC-MCMC | random-walk chain, 3,000 steps (1,500 burn-in) |
| ABC-SMC | 200 particles, 6 generations |
| Nelder-Mead | simplex search, 3 starts, 3 runs per candidate |
| DE | differential evolution (package version), 3 runs per candidate |
| Simple DE | differential evolution as a typical user would set it up (`simple_de.R`): `DEoptim` with default settings, searches ptran, crate and the starting share infected, assumes the window starts a new epidemic, one model run per candidate; ranges of the BiLSTM training data |

Every method gets the same known values (`n`, `recov`, and `incub` for SEIR) and the same
unknowns with the same ranges: **R0** (0.8-5) and **the state on the first day of the window**
(the shares exposed, infectious and recovered for SEIR; infectious and recovered for SIR),
because a window can start in the middle of an epidemic. The search methods use the package
defaults (distance: root mean squared error between simulated and observed daily counts) and
search the shares on the log scale. Only R0 = ptran x crate / recov shapes a curve, so they
search R0 directly with crate fixed at the middle of its range.

Real data have no true R0, so methods are compared by how well their simulated curves cover
the **observed daily cases**. With each method's estimates, `ModelSEIRCONN` or `ModelSIRCONN`
is run `r params$n_reps` times from the estimated state on the window's first day, and each
day's simulated count is the number of people who moved into the infectious state that day:
**E -> I for SEIR, S -> I for SIR** (from the model's transition counts). Coverage is the share
of observed days inside the 95% band of those `r params$n_reps` simulations and the interval score (band width plus 40 times how far each observed
day falls outside it; lower is better). The bands use each method's uncertainty: the BiLSTM's
R0 range and starting-state draws, the ABC posteriors, and the single Nelder-Mead or DE estimate.

The real data are counts of reported cases or hospital admissions, while these models assume
every infection is counted: they read the data as a whole small epidemic in `n` people.

# What each model knows, estimates, and the crate used by the search methods.
model_info <- function(M) {
  seir <- M == "SEIR"
  list(model = M, seir = seir,
       known = if (seir) c("n", "recov", "incub") else c("n", "recov"),
       states = if (seir) c("exposed_share", "infected_share", "recovered_share") else c("infected_share", "recovered_share"),
       crate_range = if (seir) c(5, 15) else c(1, 5))
}

# The data and the windows

```{r data}
DD <- params$real_data_dir
covid <- read.csv(file.path(DD, "utah_covid_all_days.csv")); covid$Date <- as.Date(covid$Date)
hhs <- read.csv(file.path(DD, "utah_hhs_hospital_admissions.csv")); hhs$date <- as.Date(substr(hhs$date, 1, 10)) - 1
e1918 <- new.env(); load(file.path(DD, "Flu1918.rda"), envir = e1918)
flu <- hhs$previous_day_admission_influenza_confirmed

# The part of a season with the peak: between the last week without cases before
# the peak and the first one after it.
season <- function(from, to, d, y) {
  s <- which(d >= as.Date(from) & d <= as.Date(to)); y <- y[s]
  ma <- as.numeric(stats::filter(y, rep(1 / 7, 7), sides = 2)); pk <- which.max(ma)
  zero_week <- vapply(seq_along(y), function(i) i >= 7 && all(y[(i - 6):i] == 0), logical(1))
  first <- max(c(0, which(zero_week & seq_along(y) < pk))) + 1
  after <- which(zero_week & seq_along(y) > pk)
  last  <- if (length(after)) after[1] - 7 else length(y)
  list(x = d[s][first:last], y = y[first:last])
}
utah365 <- tail(covid, 365)
DATASETS <- list(
  `Utah COVID-19 2024-25` = list(x = utah365$Date, y = utah365$Daily.Cases, n = 5000, disease = "COVID-19", anchor = "last"),
  `Utah flu 2022-23` = c(season("2022-09-01", "2023-05-31", hhs$date, flu), list(n = 5000, disease = "flu", anchor = "peak")),
  `Utah flu 2023-24` = c(season("2023-09-01", "2024-04-26", hhs$date, flu), list(n = 5000, disease = "flu", anchor = "peak")),
  `Baltimore flu 1918` = list(x = seq_along(e1918$Flu1918$incidence), y = e1918$Flu1918$incidence, n = 10000,
                              disease = "flu", anchor = "peak"),
  `Utah COVID-19 summer 2023` = c(season("2023-06-01", "2023-10-15", covid$Date, covid$Daily.Cases),
                                  list(n = 10000, disease = "COVID-19", anchor = "peak"))
)

# Windows: the last L days (Utah 2024-25), or the L days ending a week after the
# peak (moved to fit inside the data). Lengths longer than the data are skipped.
windows <- list()
for (dname in names(DATASETS)) {
  d <- DATASETS[[dname]]
  for (L in LENGTHS) {
    if (L > length(d$y)) next
    if (d$anchor == "last") {
      s <- length(d$y) - L + 1
    } else {
      ma  <- as.numeric(stats::filter(d$y, rep(1 / 7, 7), sides = 2))
      end <- min(length(d$y), which.max(ma) + 7)
      s   <- min(max(1, end - L + 1), length(d$y) - L + 1)
    }
    idx <- s:(s + L - 1)
    id  <- sprintf("w%02d", length(windows) + 1)
    windows[[id]] <- list(id = id, dataset = dname, length = L, x = d$x[idx], y = as.numeric(d$y[idx]), n = d$n,
                          recov = if (d$disease == "flu") 0.25 else 1 / 7, incub = if (d$disease == "flu") 2 else 5)
  }
}
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(windows, function(w) data.frame(window = w$id, dataset = w$dataset, days = w$length,
  first_day = format(w$x[1]), last_day = format(w$x[w$length]), total_cases = sum(w$y), n = w$n, recov = w$recov,
  incub_SEIR = w$incub))), row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
```

# The models and methods

```{r helpers}
# Run the epiworldR model for L days from a starting state. Returns the daily
# number of people who became infectious: E -> I (SEIR) or S -> I (SIR), from the
# model's transition counts on days 1 to L.
run_model <- function(info, p, L, seed) {
  if (info$seir) {
    E <- p$exposed_share; I <- p$infected_share; R <- p$recovered_share
    carriers <- E + I
    m <- epiworldR::ModelSEIRCONN(name = "sim", n = p$n, prevalence = carriers, contact_rate = p$crate,
                                  incubation_days = p$incub, transmission_rate = p$ptran, recovery_rate = p$recov)
    if (I > 0 || R > 0) epiworldR::initial_states(m, c(if (carriers > 0) I / carriers else 0, R / (1 - carriers)))
    epiworldR::verbose_off(m)
    epiworldR::run(m, ndays = L + 1L, seed = seed)
  } else {
    I <- p$infected_share; R <- p$recovered_share
    m <- epiworldR::ModelSIRCONN(name = "sim", n = p$n, prevalence = I, contact_rate = p$crate,
                                 transmission_rate = p$ptran, recovery_rate = p$recov)
    if (R > 0) epiworldR::initial_states(m, R / (1 - I))
    epiworldR::verbose_off(m)
    epiworldR::run(m, ndays = L, seed = seed)
  }
  tr <- epiworldR::get_hist_transition_matrix(m)
  tr <- tr[tr$state_from == (if (info$seir) "Exposed" else "Susceptible") & tr$state_to == "Infected", ]
  x  <- tr$counts[match(seq_len(L), tr$date)]
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  as.numeric(x)
}
# Shares drawn or searched separately; above 95% of the population in total they are scaled down.
cap_shares <- function(sh) sh * min(1, 0.95 / max(sum(sh), 1e-12))
known_of <- function(info, w) {
  k <- data.frame(n = w$n, recov = w$recov)
  if (info$seir) k$incub <- w$incub
  k
}
```

## The BiLSTMs and their R0 ranges

As in `Clean_any_length.Rmd`: the average of 5 seeds, and for the range the
`r K_NB` calibration windows with the most similar estimates, known values and length.

```{r bilstm, eval=!identical(params$stop_after, "methods")}
lg <- function(x) log(x + STATE_OFFSET)
make_bilstm <- function(M) {
  info <- INFO[[M]]
  dirs <- file.path(MODEL_DIRS[[M]], paste0("model_seed_", SEEDS))
  predict <- function(curves, known) {
    known <- as.data.frame(known)[, info$known, drop = FALSE]
    ests  <- lapply(dirs, function(d) bilstm_predict_many(d, curves, known, device = params$device))
    avg   <- Reduce(`+`, ests) / length(ests)
    avg$crate <- avg$R0 * known$recov / avg$ptran
    for (s in info$states) avg[[s]] <- pmax(avg[[s]] - STATE_OFFSET, 0)
    avg
  }
  calib <- readRDS(file.path(MODEL_DIRS[[M]], "calibration_windows.rds"))
  if (isTRUE(params$quick)) {   # a quick check: part of the calibration windows
    keep <- seq_len(min(5000, length(calib$cases)))
    calib <- list(theta = calib$theta[keep, ], length = calib$length[keep], cases = calib$cases[keep], state = calib$state[keep, ])
  }
  ce <- predict(calib$cases, calib$theta)
  features <- function(e, known, L) {
    st  <- matrix(sapply(info$states, function(s) lg(e[[s]])), nrow = nrow(e))
    out <- cbind(e$R0, st, known$recov, log(L))
    if (info$seir) out <- cbind(out, known$incub)
    out
  }
  Fc <- features(ce, calib$theta, calib$length)
  mu <- colMeans(Fc); sdv <- apply(Fc, 2, sd); Ft <- t(scale(Fc, mu, sdv))
  resid <- data.frame(R0 = calib$theta$R0 - ce$R0,
                      sapply(info$states, function(s) lg(calib$state[[s]]) - lg(ce[[s]])))
  nb <- function(e, known, L) {
    f <- (features(e, known, L)[1, ] - mu) / sdv
    d <- colSums((Ft - f)^2)
    which(d <= sort(d, partial = K_NB)[K_NB])[seq_len(K_NB)]
  }
  list(info = info, predict = predict,
       fit = function(w) {
         known <- known_of(info, w)
         t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
         e  <- predict(list(w$y), known)
         j  <- nb(e, known, w$length)
         secs <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
         draws <- lapply(sample(j, N_REPS, replace = TRUE), function(i) {
           R0 <- max(0.05, e$R0 + resid$R0[i])
           sh <- cap_shares(vapply(info$states, function(s) max(exp(lg(e[[s]]) + resid[[s]][i]) - STATE_OFFSET, 0), 0))
           c(as.list(known), list(ptran = e$ptran, crate = R0 * known$recov / e$ptran), as.list(sh))
         })
         list(R0 = e$R0, R0_range = e$R0 + quantile(resid$R0[j], c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE),
              state = unlist(e[info$states]), draws = draws, seconds = secs)
       })
}
set.seed(1)
BILSTM <- lapply(setNames(names(MODEL_DIRS), names(MODEL_DIRS)), make_bilstm)
```

## The search-based methods

```{r search-setup}
search_parts <- function(M) {
  info <- INFO[[M]]
  crate <- mean(info$crate_range)
  pars_of <- function(theta, known) {
    sh <- cap_shares(exp(unlist(theta[paste0("log_", info$states)])))
    names(sh) <- info$states
    c(as.list(known), list(ptran = theta[["R0"]] * known$recov / crate, crate = crate), as.list(sh))
  }
  bounds <- c(list(R0 = c(0.8, 5)),
              setNames(lapply(info$states, function(s) log(c(STATE_OFFSET, if (s == "recovered_share") 0.95 else 0.4))),
                       paste0("log_", info$states)))
  list(info = info, crate = crate, bounds = bounds, pars_of = pars_of,
       simulator = function(L) new_simulator(
         sample_parameters = function(n_sims) stop("Not used."),
         run = function(parameters, seed) {
           p <- pars_of(unlist(parameters[names(bounds)]), parameters[info$known])
           run_model(info, p, L, seed)
         }, type = M))
}
SEARCH <- lapply(setNames(names(MODEL_DIRS), names(MODEL_DIRS)), search_parts)

unit_file <- function(M, id, method) file.path(run_dir, sprintf("%s_%s_%s.rds", M, id, method))
posterior_draws <- function(res, n = N_REPS) {
  post <- res$posterior
  if (is.null(post)) return(NULL)
  th <- if (is.matrix(post)) post[unique(round(seq(1, nrow(post), length.out = n))), , drop = FALSE] else
    post$particles[sample(nrow(post$particles), n, replace = TRUE, prob = post$weights), , drop = FALSE]
  as.data.frame(th)
}
run_unit <- function(M, id, method) {
  f <- unit_file(M, id, method)
  if (file.exists(f)) return(invisible(f))
  S <- SEARCH[[M]]; w <- windows[[id]]
  known <- known_of(S$info, w)
  if (method == "SimpleDE") {
    res <- tryCatch(simple_de(w$y, M, known, S$info$crate_range,
                              run = function(p, L, seed) run_model(S$info, p, L, seed)), error = function(e) e)
    failed <- inherits(res, "error")
    saveRDS(list(model = M, id = id, method = method, seconds = if (failed) NA else res$seconds,
                 estimate = if (failed) NULL else res$estimate, R0_range = c(NA, NA), draws = NULL,
                 model_runs = if (failed) NA else res$model_runs,
                 error = if (failed) conditionMessage(res) else NA_character_), f)
    return(invisible(f))
  }
  set.seed(2025)
  cal <- do.call(make_calibrator, c(list(method, S$simulator(w$length), S$bounds, S$info$known), METHOD_SETTINGS[[method]]))
  t0  <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  res <- tryCatch(do.call(calibrate, c(list(w$y, cal), as.list(known))), error = function(e) e)
  failed <- inherits(res, "error")
  saveRDS(list(
    model = M, id = id, method = method, seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0,
    estimate = if (failed) NULL else calibration_estimate(res),
    R0_range = if (!failed && !is.null(res$intervals)) unname(res$intervals["R0", ]) else c(NA, NA),
    draws = if (failed) NULL else posterior_draws(res),
    model_runs = if (failed) NA else res$diagnostics$n_model_runs,
    error = if (failed) conditionMessage(res) else NA_character_
  ), f)
  invisible(f)
}

units <- expand.grid(model = names(MODEL_DIRS), id = names(windows), method = SEARCH_METHODS, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
units$days <- vapply(units$id, function(i) windows[[i]]$length, 0)
# Slowest first (DE, long windows), so no core is left with a long unit at the end.
units <- units[order(match(units$method, c("DE", "SimpleDE", "NelderMead", "ABC-SMC", "ABC-MCMC")), -units$days), ]
units <- units[!file.exists(unit_file(units$model, units$id, units$method)), ]
if (nrow(units)) {
  done <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(k) try(run_unit(units$model[k], units$id[k], units$method[k])),
                             mc.cores = CORES, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
  bad <- vapply(done, inherits, logical(1), what = "try-error")
  if (any(bad)) stop("Failed units: ", paste(units$model[bad], units$id[bad], units$method[bad], collapse = "; "))
}
cat("Saved method results:", length(list.files(run_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$")), "\n")
```

# Results

```{r fits}
band_of <- function(info, draws, L) {
  runs <- vapply(seq_along(draws), function(i) run_model(info, draws[[i]], L, seed = i), numeric(L))
  data.frame(median = apply(runs, 1, median), lower = apply(runs, 1, quantile, 0.025), upper = apply(runs, 1, quantile, 0.975))
}
score <- function(b, y) c(coverage = 100 * mean(y >= b$lower & y <= b$upper),
                          interval_score = mean((b$upper - b$lower) + 40 * pmax(b$lower - y, 0) + 40 * pmax(y - b$upper, 0)),
                          MAE = mean(abs(b$median - y)))
METHODS <- c("BiLSTM", SEARCH_METHODS)

fit_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fits.rds")
if (file.exists(fit_file)) {
  fits <- readRDS(fit_file)
} else {
  jobs <- expand.grid(model = names(MODEL_DIRS), id = names(windows), method = METHODS, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # BiLSTM estimates first (torch in this process), then the simulations in parallel.
  bil <- list()
  for (k in which(jobs$method == "BiLSTM")) {
    set.seed(k)
    bil[[paste(jobs$model[k], jobs$id[k])]] <- BILSTM[[jobs$model[k]]]$fit(windows[[jobs$id[k]]])
  }
  fits <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(k) {
    set.seed(k)
    M <- jobs$model[k]; w <- windows[[jobs$id[k]]]; m <- jobs$method[k]; info <- INFO[[M]]
    if (m == "BiLSTM") {
      b <- bil[[paste(M, w$id)]]
      out <- list(R0 = b$R0, R0_low = b$R0_range[1], R0_high = b$R0_range[2], seconds = b$seconds, draws = b$draws)
    } else {
      u <- readRDS(unit_file(M, w$id, m))
      if (is.null(u$estimate)) return(list(model = M, id = w$id, method = m, failed = TRUE, error = u$error))
      S <- SEARCH[[M]]; known <- known_of(info, w)
      # ABC: N_REPS draws resampled from the saved posterior sample, so every method gets N_REPS simulations.
      draws <- if (m == "SimpleDE") rep(list(simple_de_pars(M, u$estimate, known)), N_REPS) else
        if (!is.null(u$draws)) lapply(sample(nrow(u$draws), N_REPS, replace = TRUE), function(i)
        S$pars_of(unlist(u$draws[i, ]), known)) else
        rep(list(S$pars_of(u$estimate[names(S$bounds)], known)), N_REPS)
      out <- list(R0 = u$estimate[["R0"]], R0_low = u$R0_range[1], R0_high = u$R0_range[2], seconds = u$seconds, draws = draws)
    }
    b <- band_of(info, out$draws, w$length)
    c(list(model = M, id = w$id, method = m, failed = FALSE, band = b), out[c("R0", "R0_low", "R0_high", "seconds")],
      as.list(score(b, w$y)))
  }, mc.cores = CORES, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
  saveRDS(fits, fit_file)
}
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fits, function(f) {
  w <- windows[[f$id]]
  if (isTRUE(f$failed)) return(data.frame(model = f$model, dataset = w$dataset, length = w$length, method = f$method,
    R0 = NA, R0_low = NA, R0_high = NA, coverage = NA, interval_score = NA, MAE = NA, seconds = NA, failed = TRUE))
  data.frame(model = f$model, dataset = w$dataset, length = w$length, method = f$method, R0 = f$R0, R0_low = f$R0_low,
             R0_high = f$R0_high, coverage = f$coverage, interval_score = f$interval_score, MAE = f$MAE,
             seconds = f$seconds, failed = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(res, file.path(OUT_DIR, "results_by_window.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
METHOD_COLS <- c(BiLSTM = "forestgreen", `ABC-MCMC` = "darkorange", `ABC-SMC` = "firebrick", NelderMead = "steelblue", DE = "goldenrod", SimpleDE = "purple")
```

## Overall

Mean over all real windows (both models' windows are the same):

```{r overall}
ok <- res[!res$failed, ]
overall <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(MODEL_DIRS), function(M) do.call(rbind, lapply(METHODS, function(m) {
  r <- ok[ok$model == M & ok$method == m, ]
  wins <- vapply(split(ok[ok$model == M, ], paste(ok$dataset, ok$length)[ok$model == M]),
                 function(x) x$method[which.min(x$interval_score)] == m, logical(1))
  data.frame(model = M, method = m, windows = nrow(r), failed = sum(res$model == M & res$method == m & res$failed),
             mean_coverage_pct = mean(r$coverage), mean_interval_score = mean(r$interval_score),
             best_interval_score_in = sum(wins), mean_seconds = mean(r$seconds))
}))))
write.csv(overall, file.path(OUT_DIR, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(overall, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("model", "method", "windows", "failed", "mean coverage %", "mean interval score",
                           "lowest score in (windows)", "seconds per window"))
```

## By dataset and window length

Coverage % of the observed daily counts by each method's 95% band (`r N_REPS` simulations).

```{r by-dataset, results="asis"}
cov_tab <- ok[, c("model", "dataset", "length", "method", "coverage")]
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) {
  w <- reshape(cov_tab[cov_tab$model == M, -1], idvar = c("dataset", "length"), timevar = "method", direction = "wide")
  names(w) <- sub("coverage.", "", names(w), fixed = TRUE)
  w <- w[order(match(w$dataset, names(DATASETS)), w$length), c("dataset", "length", intersect(METHODS, names(w)))]
  write.csv(w, file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("coverage_by_dataset_", M, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  cat(knitr::kable(w, digits = 0, row.names = FALSE, caption = paste(M, ": coverage % (empty = the method failed)")),
      sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
by_ds <- aggregate(coverage ~ model + dataset + method, ok, mean)
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) {
  w <- reshape(by_ds[by_ds$model == M, -1], idvar = "dataset", timevar = "method", direction = "wide")
  names(w) <- sub("coverage.", "", names(w), fixed = TRUE)
  cat(knitr::kable(w[match(names(DATASETS), w$dataset), c("dataset", intersect(METHODS, names(w)))], digits = 0,
                   row.names = FALSE, caption = paste(M, ": mean coverage % over the window lengths of each dataset")),
      sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## By window length

```{r by-length, results="asis"}
by_len <- aggregate(cbind(coverage, interval_score) ~ model + method + length, ok, mean)
write.csv(by_len, file.path(OUT_DIR, "summary_by_length.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) {
  for (what in c("coverage", "interval_score")) {
    w <- reshape(by_len[by_len$model == M, c("method", "length", what)], idvar = "method", timevar = "length", direction = "wide")
    names(w) <- sub(paste0(what, "."), "", names(w), fixed = TRUE)
    cat(knitr::kable(w[match(METHODS, w$method), ], digits = 1, row.names = FALSE,
                     caption = sprintf("%s: mean %s by window length (days)", M,
                                       if (what == "coverage") "coverage %" else "interval score")), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r by-length-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=4.5}
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) for (what in c("coverage", "interval_score")) {
  g <- by_len[by_len$model == M, ]
  plot(NA, xlim = range(LENGTHS), ylim = range(g[[what]]), log = if (what == "interval_score") "y" else "",
       xlab = "window length (days)", ylab = if (what == "coverage") "coverage %" else "interval score",
       main = paste(M, if (what == "coverage") "coverage" else "interval score"))
  for (m in METHODS) { h <- g[g$method == m, ]; lines(h$length, h[[what]], type = "b", pch = 16, lwd = 2, col = METHOD_COLS[[m]]) }
  if (what == "coverage") legend("bottomright", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = METHOD_COLS, legend = METHODS, cex = 0.8)
}
par(op)
```

## R0 by window length

Real data have no true R0, but a good method should give similar values for windows of
different lengths around the same wave. Lines: the estimate; shaded: the 95% range (BiLSTM
and ABC methods).

```{r r0-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) {
  op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (dname in names(DATASETS)) {
    g <- ok[ok$model == M & ok$dataset == dname, ]
    if (!nrow(g)) next
    plot(NA, xlim = range(g$length) + c(-5, 5), ylim = range(c(g$R0, g$R0_low, g$R0_high), na.rm = TRUE),
         xlab = "window length (days)", ylab = "R0", main = paste(M, "-", dname), cex.main = 0.95)
    for (k in seq_along(METHODS)) {
      h <- g[g$method == METHODS[k], ]; h <- h[order(h$length), ]
      dx <- (k - 3) * 1.5
      segments(h$length + dx, h$R0_low, h$length + dx, h$R0_high, col = adjustcolor(METHOD_COLS[[METHODS[k]]], 0.6), lwd = 2)
      lines(h$length + dx, h$R0, type = "b", pch = 16, col = METHOD_COLS[[METHODS[k]]], lwd = 1.5)
    }
  }
  plot.new(); legend("center", bty = "n", lwd = 2, pch = 16, col = METHOD_COLS, legend = METHODS)
  par(op)
}
```

```{r r0-table}
r0w <- reshape(ok[, c("model", "dataset", "length", "method", "R0")], idvar = c("model", "dataset", "length"),
               timevar = "method", direction = "wide")
names(r0w) <- sub("R0.", "", names(r0w), fixed = TRUE)
knitr::kable(r0w[order(r0w$model, r0w$dataset, r0w$length), ], digits = 2, row.names = FALSE, caption = "R0 estimates")
```

## The fits

```{r fit-plots, fig.width=15, fig.height=14, results="asis"}
for (M in names(MODEL_DIRS)) for (dname in names(DATASETS)) {
  ids <- names(Filter(function(w) w$dataset == dname, windows))
  if (!length(ids)) next
  cat("\n\n### ", M, ": ", dname, "\n\n", sep = "")
  op <- par(mfrow = c(length(ids), length(METHODS)), mar = c(2.5, 3.5, 3, 0.5))
  for (id in ids) {
    w <- windows[[id]]
    for (m in METHODS) {
      f <- Filter(function(z) z$model == M && z$id == id && z$method == m, fits)[[1]]
      if (isTRUE(f$failed)) { plot.new(); title(main = paste(m, "failed"), cex.main = 0.9); next }
      plot(w$x, f$band$median, type = "n", ylim = range(c(w$y, f$band$lower, f$band$upper)), xlab = "", ylab = "",
           cex.main = 0.85, main = sprintf("%d days, %s: R0 %.2f\ncoverage %.0f%% | score %.0f", w$length, m, f$R0,
                                           f$coverage, f$interval_score))
      polygon(c(w$x, rev(w$x)), c(f$band$upper, rev(f$band$lower)), col = adjustcolor(METHOD_COLS[[m]], 0.3), border = NA)
      lines(w$x, f$band$median, col = METHOD_COLS[[m]], lwd = 2)
      lines(w$x, w$y, col = "blue", lwd = 1.2)
    }
  }
  par(op)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
